record.title: microduck-eye-ring
record.why: MEASURED 2026-09-02 (lane T): the shelf's own check FAILed this folder for declaring ZERO interfaces, and that is now settled — cad/interfaces.json declares two MEASURED anchors, 'face_seat' (the ring's rear face at plane y -55.5000, the mesh's own y maximum, meeting part:microduck-face-part's front face measured at the SAME y -55.5000 on the other mesh — both share the identical MJCF placement so the two compare without a transform) and 'bezel_bore' (Ø14.4000 x 6.0000 at (0.0000, -58.5000, 20.0000), fit residual 0.0000 mm at 355.0 deg cover), plus the Ø30.0000 x 7.5000 outer ring, every number read off Pollen's noenoeil.stl by cecad.meshfeatures.cylinders and frozen in out/laneT/features/noenoeil.json. WHAT IS STILL MISSING, named rather than left as 'nothing measured yet': cad/part.py is still the `bin/triad new part` SKELETON — it builds no geometry at all, so this folder cannot yet be rendered, placed by the kernel, printed or checked against its own mesh. What settles it: a loader (cecad.core.Part.from_mesh on geometry/noenoeil.stl, as part:microduck-jaw does) or a parametric rebuild graded by cad-refcheck. Also open and not this lane's to close: how the bezel is retained — no fastener, groove, barb or thread exists on either mesh at the butt face, and no connection folder on this shelf describes a bonded bezel.
record.origin_why: the geometry this folder describes is Pollen Robotics' own published sim asset (reference/pollen-microduck-rl/assets/), measured but not designed here; CC BY-SA-NC 4.0 per the pollen-robotics/microduck_rl README, so usable to assemble, render, simulate and print, NOT licensed for sale.
